_meta.description: Submit a prompt to Claude.ai and capture the response. Detects auth wall; if not logged in, returns auth_required.

prompt.description: The prompt/question to send to Claude
prompt.hint: Can be any length. For multi-line, use newlines in the string.

base_url.description: URL to navigate to before submitting. Use default for new conversation.
base_url.hint: Can point to an existing conversation or a Project URL

params.prompt: Say hello in exactly one sentence.

prompt_input.description: Main chat prompt input area (ProseMirror contenteditable)

anchors.placeholder: How can I help you today?

chain.note: Check for auth wall — if on login page, fail fast

Navigate the (caller-provided, already-authenticated) tab to base_url. Added 2026-07-09 WQ-164 (recipe previously ran against whatever tab was active — timing out s2). Default base_url=claude.ai/new gives a fresh SINGLE-TURN conversation, which keeps the s7 read reliable (only one assistant message). NOTE: navigate an existing authenticated tab, NOT a cold-opened one — mirrors the chatgpt.com recipe (a cold tab intermittently redirects to /login).
settle after navigate; resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
wait for prompt_input before next step (was delay 800ms)
Type prompt and press Enter to submit

wait for streaming to START (assistant message div carries data-is-streaming='true'). Healed 2026-07-09 WQ-164: [aria-label='Stop streaming'] is dead on claude.ai. onTimeout:continue covers near-instant responses that flip to done before we observe 'true'.

Wait until the assistant message flips to data-is-streaming='false' — generation complete. Healed 2026-07-09 WQ-164 (replaces dead [aria-label='Stop streaming']). On claude.ai/new there is no prior message, so this resolves only when THIS turn finishes.
settle (was delay 500ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout

Capture the assistant message text. Healed 2026-07-09 WQ-164: [data-message-author-role] is ChatGPT's attribute, absent on claude.ai. .font-claude-response is the clean response body (no 'Claude responded:' prefix); data-is-streaming='false' div is the fallback wrapper.
